adaptations.arguments: Dart uses immutable typed request/result classes; the host validates and decodes untrusted transport JSON.
adaptations.decodeRgbInvoice: Dart takes the invoice string rather than a TypeScript string-or-object union.
adaptations.amounts: Native/core values retain u64 precision with BigInt. History uses requested outgoing versus actual incoming allocations, preserves decimal amountBaseUnits and omits JS-unsafe numeric amount. Other WebRGB numeric fields still reject unsafe integers.
adaptations.payoutChains: Flutter retains a host-owned payout chain allowlist in addition to positive EIP-155 syntax and the three supported Tron chain IDs; RN beta.36 removed its allowlist. Advertised burnRecipientNamespaces are intersected with this policy. This stricter authorization does not verify asset redemption or external payout.
adaptations.unknownTransferAssignments: Unknown native transfer shapes fail closed instead of RN's Any fallback; general core assignment parsing retains its documented legacy forms outside transfer history.
adaptations.proofConsent: A new or revoked session requires fresh proof-export approval even for a previous same-origin burn. Journal ownership is not permanent consent.
adaptations.storeOwnership: All BurnOperations instances for one wallet must share the same durable store instance and isolate owner.
adaptations.errors: Untrusted dApps receive sanitized errors, never raw native messages, wallet paths, or diagnostic causes. Typed BadRequestError maps to INVALID_PARAMS; named-asset receive/balance requests verify inventory before native dispatch so generic NotFound is not guessed to mean ASSET_NOT_FOUND.
adaptations.externalUnlock: RLN 0.17 request-based external unlock forwards ethRpcUrl. RN beta.39 still uses its flat legacy entrypoint; RGS remains unsupported and native external burns remain disabled by signer capability as in RN.
adaptations.journalErrors: Version 2 optional error strings roundtrip. New records store fixed sanitized codes, not RN raw native exception messages; proven pre-broadcast funding failures cancel, unknown outcomes remain pending.
adaptations.burnRecipient: EVM addresses normalize to lowercase; Tron addresses retain Base58Check casing after checksum/version/nonzero validation. Native commitments omit the Tron version and checksum and pad the 20 account bytes to 32. Missing or conflicting v2 journal commitments fail closed, including during recovery.
